Evolve Peptides partner program

Peptide Affiliate Program: Earn 15% Commission on Every Sale

The Evolve Peptides Affiliate Program lets content creators, researchers, and reviewers earn a flat 15% commission on every qualifying research peptide order referred through a unique affiliate link or discount code, with no cost to join. Partner with a trusted U.S. research peptide supplier offering independently verified batches, and give your audience an exclusive 15% discount on every purchase.

Join the affiliate program Affiliate log in
15%Commission on every order
15%Discount for your audience
$0Cost to join
Same dayTypical approval

How the peptide affiliate program works

Three steps from signup to your first commission. No purchase required, no fees, and nothing exclusive: you can run this alongside any other program.

1

Create your free account

Sign up at our affiliate portal in a few minutes. Approval is free and typically lands the same day, with no minimum audience size or follower count required.

2

Get your link and code

Your unique referral link is issued right away. On approval we also set up your personal 15% discount code, usually your handle, so your audience gets a real reason to buy through you instead of checking out cold.

3

Earn on every order

Every qualifying sale through your affiliate link or discount code pays you 15% of the order value, across the entire Evolve Peptides catalog, not just featured products. Payouts go out monthly via PayPal.

What your 15% commission looks like

Research peptides are not a low-ticket niche, which is exactly why this peptide affiliate program pays more than most. With an average order over $200 at Evolve Peptides, a single referred sale typically earns you $30 or more in commission, and there is no cap on how many orders you can refer or how much you can earn.

$200+Average order value
$30+Your cut of one average order
No capOn referred orders
Start earning 15%

Commission applies to qualifying product sales attributed to your link or code. Your results depend on your audience and content.

How the Evolve Peptides commission compares

A headline commission percentage only tells part of the story. What matters is what that percentage is actually worth on a real order, and whether it keeps paying you after the first sale.

Slide the table sideways to see the full comparison.

What matters Evolve Peptides A higher % elsewhere
Commission rate 15% on every order Can look bigger on paper
Order size it applies to Average order value over $200 Often paired with lower-ticket products
What you actually take home $30+ on an average order Can end up lower once order size is factored in
Repeat purchases Commission on every order you refer, not just the first Frequently first-order only

Evolve Peptides is one of the few programs in this space that pays commission on repeat orders, not just the first sale.

Why creators partner with Evolve Peptides

Your name is on the recommendation, so the research peptide supplier behind it matters. This is what your audience gets when they buy through the Evolve Peptides affiliate program.

Independently tested, publicly verifiable

Every batch of research peptides is tested by independent labs and screened for endotoxins. Your audience can verify any batch themselves on our COA lookup page, which makes your recommendation easy to stand behind. Most competing peptide affiliate programs ask you to promote purity claims your audience cannot independently check.

Commission on the full catalog

As an Evolve Peptides affiliate, you earn commission on everything in our full research peptide catalog, from GLP-1 class research compounds to BPC-157 and reconstitution solution, not a limited promo list.

Fast, discreet U.S. shipping

Every order ships quickly from the United States with tracking, so the buying experience you send your audience into reflects well on you. See why customers choose Evolve Peptides for more on our sourcing and fulfillment standards.

Real-time affiliate dashboard

Your affiliate dashboard shows clicks, orders, and commission earnings in real time, with monthly payouts via PayPal. No spreadsheets, no waiting, and no guessing what you are owed.

Who this research peptide affiliate program is for

If you have an audience in the research peptide space, this affiliate program is built for you.

  • Creators on TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, and X covering peptides and research topics
  • Bloggers and reviewers who compare research peptide suppliers
  • Podcast hosts, newsletter writers, and community owners in the research space
  • Anyone already sharing peptide content who wants a supplier worth linking

Evolve Peptides ships within the United States, so this peptide affiliate program performs best with a primarily U.S. audience. Already running codes for other brands? No problem, nothing here is exclusive.

Commission structure, payouts, and terms

Everything you need to know before you apply, in one place.

Cookie window and attribution

Your referral link uses a 180-day cookie, so you are credited for a sale even if your audience does not buy the moment they click. Your personal discount code has no expiration date and works for your audience anytime.

Payout schedule

Commissions are paid out monthly via PayPal. There is no cap on total earnings, and your dashboard shows exactly where your balance stands at all times.

Recurring commission policy

You earn a 15% commission on every qualifying order placed by customers you refer through your affiliate link or discount code. Your commissions are not limited to a customer’s first purchase, so you keep earning from repeat orders as long as customers keep purchasing through your referral link or code.

Non-exclusive by design

Nothing in the program is exclusive. You can run your Evolve Peptides link and code alongside any other partnership you already have, with no monthly sales targets to keep your account active.

Peptide affiliate program FAQ

The short version of everything creators ask before joining.

How much commission does the affiliate program pay?
You earn a 15% commission on every qualifying order placed by customers you refer through your affiliate link or discount code. The commission applies across the entire Evolve Peptides catalog, not just selected products, and there is no limit on the number of orders or referrals you can generate.
Is it free to join?
Yes. Signing up is free, there is no purchase requirement, and there are no monthly sales targets to keep your account active.
How long does approval take?
Approvals are typically completed the same day you apply. Once approved, your referral link works immediately and we set up your personal 15% discount code.
How and when do I get paid?
Payouts are sent monthly via PayPal. Your affiliate dashboard tracks clicks, orders, and earnings in real time, so you always know exactly where you stand.
Does my audience get a discount?
Yes. Your personal code gives your audience 15% off their order, which gives them a real reason to use it instead of checking out cold.
How long does the tracking cookie last?
Your referral link tracks purchases for 180 days after someone clicks it, so you still get credit even if they do not buy right away.
Do I earn commission if the same customer orders again later?
Yes. You earn a 15% commission on every qualifying order placed by customers you refer through your affiliate link or code. Unlike programs that only reward the first purchase, the Evolve Peptides affiliate program pays commission on repeat business as your audience continues ordering through your referral.
Is there a minimum payout amount?
Payouts are sent monthly via PayPal. Small balances may roll into the next monthly payout, and there is no cap on how much you can earn in total. Your dashboard always shows your current balance.
Where does Evolve Peptides ship?
We ship within the United States. The program works best for creators with a primarily U.S. audience.
Are there content rules I should know about?
Yes, one important one. All products are sold strictly for research use only, so affiliate content needs to stay in that lane: no claims about human use, effects, or benefits. You should also disclose your affiliate relationship in line with FTC Endorsement Guides.
What is a peptide affiliate program?
A peptide affiliate program allows creators, bloggers, and reviewers to earn commissions by referring their audience to a trusted research peptide supplier through a unique affiliate link or discount code. The Evolve Peptides Affiliate Program pays a 15% commission on every qualifying order, allowing partners to earn from both first-time purchases and repeat customer orders.
What kind of content can I create as a peptide affiliate?
You can create blog reviews, social videos, newsletter mentions, or comparison content, as long as it stays within research-use-only positioning: no claims of human use, effects, or medical benefits, and your affiliate relationship is disclosed per FTC guidelines.
Can I be an affiliate if I am not based in the U.S.?
You can join from anywhere, but since Evolve Peptides ships within the United States, the program performs best with a primarily U.S.-based audience.
How do I track my affiliate performance?
Your affiliate dashboard shows clicks, orders, and earnings in real time, so you can see exactly how your content is converting without waiting on manual reports.
How is Evolve Peptides different from other peptide affiliate programs?
Every batch sold is independently lab-tested for purity and screened for endotoxins, and your audience can verify any batch themselves using the public COA lookup tool. Most competing programs ask affiliates to promote purity claims their audience cannot independently check. Evolve Peptides is also one of the few programs in the space that pays recurring commission on repeat orders, not just the first sale.

Ready to partner with Evolve Peptides?

Free signup, 15% commission on every referred sale, 15% off for your audience, and a dashboard that shows your earnings in real time.

Create your affiliate account

All Evolve Peptides products are sold for research use only and are not for human consumption. Affiliates are responsible for disclosing their affiliate relationship in accordance with FTC guidelines. Buying in bulk instead? See our wholesale program.
